entities.name: Query Ham1p-like pyrophosphatase
observations: 198 aa protein; calculated molecular mass 21.84 kDa and theoretical pI 7.83.
Contains a Ham1p_like domain (Pfam PF01725.22) spanning residues 4–193.
Shares 41.0–48.7% identity over 96–99% of its length with reviewed bacterial dITP/XTP pyrophosphatases.
Likely cytosolic nucleotide-cleanup enzyme that hydrolyzes noncanonical purine nucleoside triphosphates, especially dITP, ITP, and XTP.
Homolog annotations support Mg2+ dependence and homodimerization, but these properties are inferred for the query rather than directly measured.

entities.name: Q6MJR8
observations: Reviewed Bdellovibrio bacteriovorus dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase; 48.7% identity and 99.0% query coverage to the query.
Annotated as EC 3.6.1.66, Mg2+-dependent, homodimeric, cytosolic dITP/XTP/ITP pyrophosphatase.
